## New: tabs on the lead page

The lead detail page is now split into tabs, so you're not scrolling through everything at once:

- **Overview** — the recent/upcoming task cards and quick links to the site and mockup.
- **Redesign** — the side-by-side current-site vs. new-mockup view, with desktop/mobile and the quality gate.
- **SEO audit** — the current site's Lighthouse scores and the issues found.
- **Competitors** — the benchmark set for the lead's vertical and the sites buyers compare against.
- **How to close** — the strategy brief (angle, pain points, objections, pricing, next step), now in its own tab instead of a popup.

## New: the app updates itself

Customer builds now check for updates from studio.weborite.com and install them in place — no reinstalling by hand after this version. You'll see an "App updates" section in **Settings → Plan & license** and a banner when a new version is ready. (Because the installer isn't code-signed yet, Windows SmartScreen may still warn: choose More info → Run anyway.)

## New: publish a mockup live

Publish a mockup to a Hostinger subdomain and get a real link to send. Add your SFTP details in **Settings → Integrations**, then use **Publish live** on the lead page. The live link is used in the outreach email and playbook.

## Onboarding personalization

Setup now collects your niche, writing style, case studies and design context, and feeds them into the AI that writes mockups and outreach. Edit it any time in **Settings → Profile**.

To install: download the .exe below and run it. Existing installs don't have the updater yet, so install this one by hand — updates after this are in-app.
